description: Says which Spekkr account the caller is signed in as, which specs it has published, and how each one is doing: under numbers, its newest version, its pulls, its stars, and where there are any its followers and feedback. Only the account itself is told these numbers. This tool needs sign-in: the first call opens a Spekkr page in the browser, where the person signs in with a code sent to their email address and picks a username if they are new.
name: whoami
title: Who am I on Spekkr
